page.overview:
Who is Ant Hunters?

The Ant Hunters are minor characters in A Bug's Life. They are members of Hopper's gang.

"As Dot and the Blueberries hide inside a hollow stalk, they overhear two grasshoppers talking about Hopper squashing the Queen. "She's dead. They cry. Boo hoo. We go home," one says. "Cool. I love our job," the other replies."

The Ant Hunters hunt for ants, while the Blueberry Troop is hiding nearby, inside of a stalk. One of the hunters finds something. Dot hides from him, thinking that it was her that he had found, although it was actually one of the Blueberry Troop bandannas. One of the Ant Hunters puts it on his head and asks the other how he looks with it on. The other tells him that he looks like an idiot, and the one with the bandanna still on him tells the other that he thought it would keep him dry in the rain. The other tells him that Hopper will squish the Queen, the ants will cry about it, and the grasshoppers will go home. The Ant Hunter wearing the bandanna on his head says, "cool," and that he loves his job.
